about: Model and effort grid of model-router. skills/choose-model/SKILL.md states the same grid in prose; grid.test.mjs fails when the two drift apart. A class's default is the grid's usual choice for it: the router mod and the quality loop use it as the prior.

tiers.name: haiku
tiers.fitsWhen: Simple, repetitive work whose result is easy to check, with no judgment calls.
examples: apply the same edit in many places

tiers.name: sonnet
tiers.fitsWhen: What done looks like fits in one sentence.
examples: a well-specified change across a few files
a bug whose cause is described

tiers.name: fable
tiers.fitsWhen: Large and open-ended work where judgment and accuracy really matter. Both conditions must hold.
examples: an architecture decision with long-lasting consequences

tiers.name: opus
tiers.fitsWhen: Everything else, and any time you hesitate between two tiers.
examples: debugging when the cause is unknown

questions.ask: Is it a simple task or a quick exchange?
Is it long, hard and critical, and does it run unattended? All three must hold.
Would an unnoticed mistake cost money, a client or a wrong decision?

classes.name: read-analyze
classes.covers: read and conclude: explain, compare, summarize

classes.name: edit-mechanical
classes.covers: repetitive edits that are easy to check

classes.name: edit-specified
classes.covers: a change whose done-state fits in one sentence

classes.name: review-debug
classes.covers: review, or debugging with an unknown cause
